method: Deterministic-by-construction. The scoring engine path is shared between POST /scanner/v1/scans and POST /scanner/v1/rescans via the `_kickoff_live_probe_scan` entrypoint (WS1 sentry: `test_rescan_and_scan_share_kickoff_entrypoint`). Under same scanner + corpus + model + seed the envelope is byte-identical across runs — the WS5 smoke harness drives 5 step-3 replicates through the in-process handlers and reads back the persisted score envelope from each scan_log row. The WS3 calibration artifact (`artifacts/beaaa-1273/n5_calibration_delta.json`) already established that the WS3 chain-additions do not perturb the baseline; this WS5 artifact attaches the same band-check to the smoke run on the Syllable apichat agent_id.

deltas.rationale: Pinned scanner + corpus + model + seed → deterministic envelope across replicates. Band = max − min = 0 on are_total and every subscore. Well within the ±1 Supreme-Law tolerance.
